Hero_Aurena.name: Aurena
Hero_Aurena.subtitle: Expelled Sage of the Lunar Arcanum Society
Hero_Aurena.description: Aurena is a sage from the Lunar Arcanum Society who was expelled for researching forbidden knowledge. She is a battle healer who dismantles her own life force to wield its power.
Hero_Aurena.achievementDescription: Heal yourself or allies for a total of 25,000 Health.

Hero_Bismuth.name: Bismuth
Hero_Bismuth.subtitle: One Body, Two Minds
Hero_Bismuth.description: Bismuth is the fusion of an empty, nameless spellbook and an ordinary blind girl. She moves swiftly and deals sustained ranged damage.

Hero_Husk.name: Shell
Hero_Husk.subtitle: Manufactured Assassin, Wooden Doll with a Soul

Hero_Lacerta.name: Lacerta
Hero_Lacerta.subtitle: Former Sniper, Hunter Lizard
Hero_Lacerta.description: Lacerta is a former Royal Guard sniper and hunter skilled with firearms and gunpowder. He is used to taking out enemies from a distance.

Hero_Mist.name: Mist
Hero_Mist.subtitle: Duelist of House Verdesilver
Hero_Mist.description: Mist is a brave duelist of noble birth. Her agile fighting style allows her to dodge deadly attacks and quickly take down her enemies.

Hero_Nachia.name: Nachia
Hero_Nachia.subtitle: Spirit Mage of the Dream World, Guardian of the Ethereal Forest

Hero_Vesper.name: Vesper
Hero_Vesper.subtitle: Ruthless Inquisitor of the Order of the Sacred Flame
Hero_Vesper.description: Vesper is the leader of the Order of the Sacred Flame and a ruthless inquisitor. He fights at close range, holding back enemies while dealing heavy damage.

Hero_Yubar.name: Yubar
Hero_Yubar.subtitle: Born of Dreams, God of Stars
Hero_Yubar.description: Yubar is a fantastical being born from dreams, a deity who governs the creation and destruction of stars. He uses powerful magic to deal heavy damage from a distance.

St_C_BeamOfLight.lore:
-- Experiment Log, Year 3, Day 20 of Month 1
-- Author: Carrier Bayonet
-- Research Subject: Beam of Light


Subject: Young widow. Severe burns from face to shoulders. Infected wound on cheekbone.
Result: Cheekbone infection visibly reduced. Burns appear slightly faded.

Subject: Boy. Open wounds on back from whipping.
Result: Back wounds healing well. Boy claims his "thieving habit" is now "cured" and demands to be released.

Subject: Jeff (the infamous murderer). Gunshot wounds to both ankles and wrists.
Result: Complained of intense head pain, then a small "pop" sound was heard before he passed out.
Note: Still breathing but remains unconscious.


P.S. His Majesty King Rojit has provided 10 additional death row inmates. Much research remains on this beam, but one thing is certain: this power of dreams will save many lives.

St_C_MagicSword.lore:
In the quiet dawn,
when I visit the back garden of Highgate Manor,
a memory rises, unbidden.

The cool air of the old training hall, still brushing against my cheek.
My childhood self, casting only the smallest of shadows.
Mother's voice, sharp as frost.

The Teal Blade.
The family sword—strength and pride of House Verdesilver.
Like a steadfast tree, straight and unwavering,
Mother showed me the blade that day.

But my sword could not follow her teachings.
The tip trembled like a leaf dancing in the wind, and my strength flowed away like water.

Isn't it ironic, Mother?
The proud tree you fought so hard to protect has fallen and broken,
while this worthless leaf, scattered by the wind,
is the one that survived.

Now the family's pride is gone, the weight of the tree lifted...
but I have no regrets.

All I wish for now is...
to wield this blade as a nameless mist that has lost its teal,
for the happiness of my younger sibling.

St_C_MassProtection.lore:
Every time the Moonlight Council convenes, we extend this great barrier. It is a solemn act, signifying that the Society exists solely in the pursuit of truth, under the profound and absolute belief that we must not interfere in any affairs of the outside world.

Lately, however, I have felt a strange dissonance and a cold realization within this absolute silence. This perfect peace so thoroughly erases the cries of countless lives fading away outside, and our "neutrality" is merely a noble privilege gained at the cost of remaining silent before their suffering.

For some reason, I am reminded of that child's face. Aurena. I realize that the logic we used to block her "dangerous" inquiries bears an uncanny resemblance to the logic we now use with this barrier, shutting out the "dangerous" chaos of the world.

Are we truly "protecting" the truth? Or are we merely "protecting" ourselves from everything we have given up trying to understand?

I wonder if this sacred protection ultimately serves not our sublime neutrality, but our deepest cowardice. I still do not know the answer.

St_C_SparklingWaterGun.lore:
Backstreet Tips #5:

Ingredients: Nettles you find along the roadside, and a poisonous herb with red-tipped leaves (don't know the name).
Preparation: Grind them up in a stone mortar and mix with water.
Use: Perfect for leaving stains on the fancy cloaks of those pretentious nobles. If any touch their skin, they will be dealing with a tingling itch for days. Consider that a little bonus.
Analysis: There's nothing better for getting under their skin.

For rats like us, this is the only way to tug at the cat's whiskers. Life is precious, after all.

St_C_Whirlwind.lore:
Excerpt from the Chronicles of the Forgotten Snowy Mountain:

In the days before the great mountain was broken, giant children played a game called "Chasing the Blizzard." Each child would carry a small wooden axe, mimicking their ruler, Skoll. His wild, spinning destruction appeared to them as a hero's dance and a song of glory.

The children would spin around until they collapsed from dizziness, dreaming that one day they too might protect the mountain as the great storm itself.

No one knew.

The hero's dance they so admired would become the very storm that shattered their world. The song of glory they sang would turn into the mountain's dirge.

St_E_AntiGravity.lore:
Our master, Lord Erebos, simply wished to please Lady Nyx.

When he lightly stomped his foot in the starry forest, steadfast mountain ranges would rise and float like pebbles, suspended by a thread. With a single gesture of his hand, the earth would split apart and rise again, creating new landscapes. Our master would laugh like a child at these magnificent sights. Thet power that shook the heavens was nothing more than a dazzling proof of love meant for one alone.

Yet was I the only one who saw the cold shadow cross Lady Nyx's face in those moments?

What shone in her eyes was not joy, but awe and... a fierce spark of jealousy she could not conceal.


- Memory trace of a nameless night spirit.

Hunting Journal
Year o of Rojit's Rule, Day oo of Month o, Weather: Cloudy
Hunting Location: Hising Forest
Today's Harvest: A few wild strawberries


Whenever I see something burning, it pulls me back to that day.
The sight of my wife, suddenly engulfed in flames and gone.

It happened in an instant. She turned to ash, consumed by a blue flame so bright it made my eyes sting.

I checked all my ammo and powder pouches, but nothing was missing.
Something was off. A fire that burns that fast without smoke, without even being hot... it's not natural.

Then today, while watching some archers through my scope, I discovered something very interesting.

That there are bastards out there who can wield blue flames.

...

First things first, I need more information.

I have to be careful if I want to get my wife back. For now, I have to swallow this boiling rage.

-- Experiment Log
-- Day 273 since the experiment began
-- Written by Aurena


A partial success.
I've managed to control the power of lightning to some extent, but it's inherently unstable. The electrical discharge jumps unpredictably to unintended targets.

However, I've stumbled upon something even more significant. I've uncovered an insight into the fundamental power of dreams, but I'm running out of space in this log. For now, I'll refer to this as "Dismantling Force" and continue my research.

St_E_ClutchesOfMalice.lore:
How many days have I been lost in this twisted dream world?
As my sense of time dulled, something began to take shape before my eyes.
Beyond the mist, "I" was standing there.

At first I was merely curious, but the moment I met its gaze, I realized what writhed in those depths was not my soul, but something strange and damp. It was fear itself.
As it slowly reached toward me, its back split open and blood-red tentacles burst forth. At their ends hung not just pieces of flesh, but living eyeballs, staring intently at me like seeds planted to spread this nightmare across the world.
Only then did I understand. That was not my reflection in a mirror. It was a hungry clutch of nightmares, using me as a host and seeking to consume this world.


- Memory trace engraved in someone's fragment

St_E_FinalExplosion.lore:
The encirclement of the Order of the Sacred Flame tightened without a single gap.
Their holy flames denied even the deepest alley its darkness.
Cornered at a dead end, the Lucid Sect member finally stopped.

But instead of fear, a strange, ecstatic smile crossed his face.
He looked down at the knights closing in on him as if they were pitiful insects.

"You think... this is the end? Do you truly believe you can judge me with that false god's arrogant little flame?"

He closed his eyes and focused all his senses.
Beyond the clamor of reality, he heard it—the gentle whisper of the dream world,
the Rapids he had longed for.

Now, it was time to abandon everything and depart.
He opened his eyes once more to bid a final farewell to reality.

"Farewell! You blind flames... this worthless flesh... and this wretched world!"

His body began to flicker violently, taking on an otherworldly hue.
A prayer—the most fervent and desperate offering to his god.

"Lord Primus! This lowly servant offers... everything I am... to you now!"

His final cry reduced his very existence to a handful of dust,
becoming a magnificent final explosion that consumed everything.


— Memory trace from a corpse in a ruined village

St_E_FlameJet.lore:
Hunting Journal
2nd Year of Rojit's Rule, Day xx of Month x, Weather: Clear
Hunting Location: Igni Wetlands
Today's Harvest: A pocketful of nettles

There are rules I always follow when I go hunting in the Igni Wetlands.

1. Be cautious if you spot claw marks on mangrove roots.

2. If those marks aren't covered in moss, steer clear of that direction.

3. If you see smoke in the distance or smoldering embers on charred trees, head home immediately.

I made these rules after what I saw through my scope last summer. Some fool tugged on a half-scorched Kalimberry vine and came face to face with a monstrous Barasus.

I don't think I've seen flames that big, not even at the Royal Guard's fire weapon demonstrations.

After hearing rumors about Shangri-La, I returned to the Puppeteer's workshop.

The abandoned corpses remained, and the ruins carried their familiar stench. My memory tells me this is where the tragedy that took everything from me began. Yet my body and mind showed no reaction, just as I expected.

I wasn't here for sentimentality. I had another purpose. Amidst the ruins, I found traces of a memory, seemingly hidden by the Puppeteer.

It was the memory of a swordsman I did not know, carrying a foreign blade, not of eastern origin. He was not simply cutting; he had captured the abyss within his sword and wielded the void itself.

A strange sense of kinship came over me. I understood that sword. It was a kind of emptiness that only those with hollow souls could inhabit.

My breath... was stolen away.
Screams froze in the air, and the bone-piercing cold stripped me of all feeling.

That wolf's howl was not of a victor. It was the wail of one who had lost everything, the desperate scream of a shattered kingdom.
And we died beneath that crushing despair, nothing more than dust, choking on our helplessness.
This blizzard is not mere cold.
It carries his despair mixed with my curse, his sorrow swirling with my rage.

This is a living hell.


- Memory trace of a mercenary buried in the Snowy Mountain, moments before death.

St_L_MentalCorruption.lore:
As I wander through this world, I sometimes meet people who are aware of the dream world. A rare few remember our encounters completely, allowing us to keep connecting again and again.

One day, while speaking with one of them as usual, I noticed the light suddenly fade from their eyes. That empty gaze was fixed on me.

"Is she truly happy here?"

Suddenly, he called out to me with a question.

"Or is she merely a beautiful doll trapped in your perfect cage?"

In that moment, my world shook. A wave of fear froze my heart. As if my anxiety were contagious, everyone around us began to warp, their hidden hatred and fear for each other rising to the surface.

With my power, I erased the source of that corruption, leaving not a single trace behind. Like an illusion, the chaos vanished, and the world slipped back into its false tranquility. But I saw it. In the shadows, something unseen was mocking my deepest self.

No. This utopia is mine. My wife... my family must be real. I cannot lose them again.

I will make sure this never happens again. No cracks, no doubts.

Never again, will I allow it.

Heretic, why do you flee?
My mace simply leads lost sheep back to the righteous path. No one escapes this teaching. If the price of learning is broken bones, then that is the price that must be paid.
St_Q_Discipline.achievementDescription: Have 3 Dash or Teleport Memories at once as Vesper.

St_Q_EtherealInfluence.name: Ether's Influence
St_Q_EtherealInfluence.description: Launch <color=yellow>Ether</color> that moves forward and returns, dealing  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>160%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Light damage</color> to enemies. Reactivate to cause <color=yellow>Ether</color> to <color=yellow>explode</color>, dealing  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>180%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Light damage</color> and <color=yellow>rooting</color> enemies for 3 seconds.
St_Q_EtherealInfluence.rawDesc: Launch <color=yellow>Ether</color> that moves forward and returns, dealing {0} <color=yellow>Light damage</color> to enemies. Reactivate to cause <color=yellow>Ether</color> to <color=yellow>explode</color>, dealing {1} <color=yellow>Light damage</color> and <color=yellow>rooting</color> enemies for {2} seconds.
St_Q_EtherealInfluence.lore:
Behold, this most fundamental substance.
From your soul to the earth beneath your feet, it is the beginning and end of all existence.
Like the first breath of the universe itself...

St_Q_Fleche.name: Flèche
St_Q_Fleche.description:
Dash toward the target, dealing  <sprite=2><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ad>140%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color>, immediately performing a <color=yellow>basic attack</color>, and temporarily increasing <color=yellow>Mist</color>'s <color=yellow>Movement Speed</color>. If this <color=yellow>damage</color> kills the target, restore  15<sprite=5>  Health and reduce the <color=yellow>cooldown</color> by 15%.

<color=yellow>Charges</color> are fully restored at once.
St_Q_Fleche.rawDesc:
Dash toward the target, dealing {0} <color=yellow>damage</color>, immediately performing a <color=yellow>basic attack</color>, and temporarily increasing <color=yellow>Mist</color>'s <color=yellow>Movement Speed</color>. If this <color=yellow>damage</color> kills the target, restore {1} Health and reduce the <color=yellow>cooldown</color> by {2}.

<color=yellow>Charges</color> are fully restored at once.
St_Q_Fleche.achievementDescription: Defeat any elemental 75 times as Mist.

St_Q_GoldenBurst.name: Golden Explosion
St_Q_GoldenBurst.description:
Create a Golden Explosion forward that deals  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>110%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Light damage</color> to enemies and <color=yellow>restores</color>  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>28%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  Health to allies. When hitting a single target, this explosion's <color=yellow>damage</color> or <color=yellow>healing</color> is increased by 100%.

Upon casting, gain stacks of <color=yellow>Wither</color> for 3.5 seconds and <color=yellow>sacrifice</color> 5% of your Maximum Health. Each <color=yellow>Wither</color> stack increases the explosion's <color=yellow>damage</color> and <color=yellow>healing</color> by 100%, but also increases the Health <color=yellow>sacrificed</color> by 7% of your Maximum Health.
St_Q_GoldenBurst.rawDesc:
Create a Golden Explosion forward that deals {0} <color=yellow>Light damage</color> to enemies and <color=yellow>restores</color> {1} Health to allies. When hitting a single target, this explosion's <color=yellow>damage</color> or <color=yellow>healing</color> is increased by {2}.

Upon casting, gain stacks of <color=yellow>Wither</color> for {3} seconds and <color=yellow>sacrifice</color> {4} of your Maximum Health. Each <color=yellow>Wither</color> stack increases the explosion's <color=yellow>damage</color> and <color=yellow>healing</color> by {5}, but also increases the Health <color=yellow>sacrificed</color> by {6} of your Maximum Health.
St_Q_GoldenBurst.lore:
The amount of decomposition energy input is directly proportional to the destructive power output.

The fatigue that follows each experiment is interesting, but not particularly important.

St_Q_HandCannon.name: Hand Cannon
St_Q_HandCannon.description: Shoot a blazing bullet that pushes you backward, dealing  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>80%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Fire damage</color> to enemies in front. Nearby enemies that are hit instead take  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>180%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Fire damage</color> and are knocked back.
St_Q_HandCannon.rawDesc: Shoot a blazing bullet that pushes you backward, dealing {0} <color=yellow>Fire damage</color> to enemies in front. Nearby enemies that are hit instead take {1} <color=yellow>Fire damage</color> and are knocked back.
St_Q_HandCannon.lore: Just a single use makes it very difficult to maintain the firearm.

St_Q_IncendiaryRounds.name: Incendiary Rounds
St_Q_IncendiaryRounds.description: The next 4 basic attacks are  60%<sprite=5>  faster and deal an additional  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>100%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Fire damage</color>, briefly increasing <color=yellow>Lacerta</color>'s <color=yellow>Movement Speed</color>.
St_Q_IncendiaryRounds.rawDesc: The next {0} basic attacks are {1} faster and deal an additional {2} <color=yellow>Fire damage</color>, briefly increasing <color=yellow>Lacerta</color>'s <color=yellow>Movement Speed</color>.
St_Q_IncendiaryRounds.lore: Lacerta shared many fiery wonders with his wife, who loved the beauty of flames, but he never let her handle incendiary rounds, insisting they were far too dangerous.
St_Q_IncendiaryRounds.achievementDescription: Defeat the Heroic Boss 5 times as Lacerta.

St_Q_Laceration.name: Laceration
St_Q_Laceration.description:
Each basic attack alternates Laceration's form between <color=#f28a8a>Red Form</color> and <color=#8ab2f2>Blue Form</color>. When cast, it unleashes a different effect depending on the current form.

<color=#f28a8a>Red Form:</color> Dash a short distance, slashing enemies in a narrow area for  <sprite=2><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ad>155%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Dark Damage</color> and triggering <color=yellow>Attack Effects</color>. Upon first hitting an enemy, its <color=yellow>Cooldown</color> is reduced by 35%.

<color=#8ab2f2>Blue Form:</color> Leap into the air to become briefly <color=yellow>Invulnerable</color>, then swing your blade to deal  <sprite=2><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ad>230%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Dark Damage</color> and trigger <color=yellow>Attack Effects</color> on all nearby enemies. For each enemy hit, the <color=yellow>Cooldown</color> is reduced by 15%, up to a maximum of 60%.
St_Q_Laceration.rawDesc:
Each basic attack alternates Laceration's form between <color=#f28a8a>Red Form</color> and <color=#8ab2f2>Blue Form</color>. When cast, it unleashes a different effect depending on the current form.

<color=#f28a8a>Red Form:</color> Dash a short distance, slashing enemies in a narrow area for {0} <color=yellow>Dark Damage</color> and triggering <color=yellow>Attack Effects</color>. Upon first hitting an enemy, its <color=yellow>Cooldown</color> is reduced by {1}.

<color=#8ab2f2>Blue Form:</color> Leap into the air to become briefly <color=yellow>Invulnerable</color>, then swing your blade to deal {2} <color=yellow>Dark Damage</color> and trigger <color=yellow>Attack Effects</color> on all nearby enemies. For each enemy hit, the <color=yellow>Cooldown</color> is reduced by {3}, up to a maximum of {4}.
St_Q_Laceration.lore:
To cut, or to evade. The choice is an illusion.
All that changes is the form of the movement.

St_Q_Lunge.name: Lunge
St_Q_Lunge.description: Dodge forward and thrust your saber toward the nearest enemy. Hitting an enemy with the saber reduces the <color=yellow>cooldown</color> of <color=yellow>Swift Steps</color> by 60%. Triggers <color=yellow>attack effects</color> and deals  <sprite=2><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ad>200%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  damage to all enemies hit. Each time <color=yellow>Astrid's Masterpiece</color> triggers, reduce this Memory's <color=yellow>cooldown</color> by 0.5 seconds.
St_Q_Lunge.rawDesc: Dodge forward and thrust your saber toward the nearest enemy. Hitting an enemy with the saber reduces the <color=yellow>cooldown</color> of <color=yellow>Swift Steps</color> by {0}. Triggers <color=yellow>attack effects</color> and deals {1} damage to all enemies hit. Each time <color=yellow>Astrid's Masterpiece</color> triggers, reduce this Memory's <color=yellow>cooldown</color> by {2} seconds.

St_Q_MoonlightPact.name: Moonlight Pact
St_Q_MoonlightPact.description:
<color=yellow>Fenrir</color> leaps to the target location, slashing enemies for  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>200%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color> and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. For each enemy hit, <color=yellow>Fenrir</color> <color=yellow>heals</color> for  8%<sprite=5>  of his Maximum Health. Each time <color=yellow>Fenrir</color> attacks, the <color=yellow>cooldown</color> of this ability is reduced by 1 seconds.

<color=yellow>Passive Effect:</color> <color=yellow>Summons</color> <color=yellow>Fenrir the Werewolf</color>, who follows Nachia. <color=yellow>Fenrir</color> has 321 Health and  40<sprite=5>  Armor, claws enemies for  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>130%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color>, and triggers 50% <color=yellow>attack effects</color>.
St_Q_MoonlightPact.rawDesc:
<color=yellow>Fenrir</color> leaps to the target location, slashing enemies for {0} <color=yellow>damage</color> and stunning them for {1} seconds. For each enemy hit, <color=yellow>Fenrir</color> <color=yellow>heals</color> for {2} of his Maximum Health. Each time <color=yellow>Fenrir</color> attacks, the <color=yellow>cooldown</color> of this ability is reduced by {3} seconds.

<color=yellow>Passive Effect:</color> <color=yellow>Summons</color> <color=yellow>Fenrir the Werewolf</color>, who follows Nachia. <color=yellow>Fenrir</color> has {4} Health and {5} Armor, claws enemies for {6} <color=yellow>damage</color>, and triggers {7} <color=yellow>attack effects</color>.
St_Q_MoonlightPact.lore:
The pact with the moonlight was once a joyful game to quell the mischievous chaos of a playful sibling. 
The moonlight still answers her call, but its light no longer carries the same weight.
St_Q_MoonlightPact.achievementDescription: Enter the Pure White Dream 2 times as Nachia.

St_Q_Reduction.name: Reduction
St_Q_Reduction.description: <color=yellow>Sacrifice</color> 8% of your Maximum Health to throw thin Gold Shards forward 3 times. The Gold Shards pierce through targets, dealing  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>95%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color> to enemies hit and <color=yellow>healing</color> allies for  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>18%</gradient></color><sprite=5> .
St_Q_Reduction.rawDesc: <color=yellow>Sacrifice</color> {0} of your Maximum Health to throw thin Gold Shards forward {1} times. The Gold Shards pierce through targets, dealing {2} <color=yellow>damage</color> to enemies hit and <color=yellow>healing</color> allies for {3}.
St_Q_Reduction.lore:
The essence of my research is not destruction, but "reduction." I return objects to their most fundamental particles, then reconstruct them according to my will.
This is the true realm of creation, something the stagnant minds of Arcanum could never imagine.
St_Q_Reduction.achievementDescription: Cast Golden Explosion 9 times within 5 seconds as Aurena.

St_Q_SuperNova.name: Supernova
St_Q_SuperNova.description:
Creates an expanding star at the target location that slows enemies, then channels for up to 3 seconds. You can't attack or use Memories while channeling. Reactivating <color=yellow>Supernova</color> detonates the star, dealing  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>200%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Light damage</color> to enemies. The explosion becomes more powerful with charge time, increasing damage up to 225% after 1.3 seconds.
Charge speed increases proportionally to Yubar's Memory Haste.
St_Q_SuperNova.rawDesc:
Creates an expanding star at the target location that slows enemies, then channels for up to {0} seconds. You can't attack or use Memories while channeling. Reactivating <color=yellow>Supernova</color> detonates the star, dealing {1} <color=yellow>Light damage</color> to enemies. The explosion becomes more powerful with charge time, increasing damage up to {2} after {3} seconds.
Charge speed increases proportionally to Yubar's Memory Haste.
St_Q_SuperNova.shortDescription: Charge to deal powerful Light damage
St_Q_SuperNova.lore:
What a beautiful and tragic paradox.
Stars burn their very essence to shine their brightest,
only for that moment to signal the start of eternal silence.

St_Q_SylvanCall.name: Sylvan Call
St_Q_SylvanCall.description:
<color=yellow>Summon</color> a <color=yellow>Leaf Hound</color> that follows Nachia at the target location, dealing  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>130%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color> to enemies and <color=yellow>stunning</color> them for 0.4 seconds.

The <color=yellow>Leaf Hound</color> has 128 Health and 40 Armor, remains on the battlefield for up to 25 seconds, and claws enemies to deal  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>60%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color>. You can have up to 5 Leaf Hounds summoned at once.
St_Q_SylvanCall.rawDesc:
<color=yellow>Summon</color> a <color=yellow>Leaf Hound</color> that follows Nachia at the target location, dealing {0} <color=yellow>damage</color> to enemies and <color=yellow>stunning</color> them for {1} seconds.

The <color=yellow>Leaf Hound</color> has {2} Health and {3} Armor, remains on the battlefield for up to {4} seconds, and claws enemies to deal {5} <color=yellow>damage</color>. You can have up to {6} Leaf Hounds summoned at once.
St_Q_SylvanCall.lore:
The purest spirits in the Ethereal Forest are born from fallen leaves and morning dew.
When Nachia, the guardian of the forest, calls out, these strange "hounds" willingly appear to answer her call.

St_QR_DistortedMind.name: Distorted Mind
St_QR_DistortedMind.description: <color=yellow>Hold</color> to charge a volley of psychic arrows. Release to rain 1~ 4<sprite=5>  psychic arrows on nearby enemies, based on charge time. Each psychic arrow deals  <sprite=2><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ad>200%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Dark damage</color> to enemies in a small area.
St_QR_DistortedMind.rawDesc: <color=yellow>Hold</color> to charge a volley of psychic arrows. Release to rain {0}~{1} psychic arrows on nearby enemies, based on charge time. Each psychic arrow deals {2} <color=yellow>Dark damage</color> to enemies in a small area.
St_QR_DistortedMind.lore:
But the world as the girl saw it was, at times, terribly twisted. 

When the old book in her mind imagined mischievous stories, 
fragments of distorted thoughts poured down from the sky like black rain. 

Those caught in this rain 
became trapped in the darkest chamber of the mind.
St_QR_DistortedMind.achievementDescription: Deal a total of 250,000 Dark damage to enemies as Bismuth.

St_QR_InfernalTales.name: Tales of Hellfire
St_QR_InfernalTales.description: Creates a ring of flames around you for 3 seconds. Enemies touching the flame ring take  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>350%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Fire damage</color> per second.
St_QR_InfernalTales.rawDesc: Creates a ring of flames around you for {0} seconds. Enemies touching the flame ring take {1} <color=yellow>Fire damage</color> per second.
St_QR_InfernalTales.lore:
One day, the girl read a story about a mighty dragon. 

"I want to be strong like a dragon too!" 

As she thought this, 
the old book cheerfully turned its pages. 

Soon, flames like a dragon's hot breath rose from the girl's body, 
and everyone around her smiled more brightly than any star as they danced with her.
St_QR_InfernalTales.achievementDescription: Defeat a Heroic Boss without taking any damage as Bismuth.

St_QR_Innocence.name: Pure Soul
St_QR_Innocence.description: Fires  3<sprite=5>  soul missiles at nearby enemies. Each missile explodes, dealing  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>108%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Light Damage</color> to enemies and slowing their <color=yellow>Movement Speed</color> by 60% for 1 seconds.
St_QR_Innocence.rawDesc: Fires {0} soul missiles at nearby enemies. Each missile explodes, dealing {1} <color=yellow>Light Damage</color> to enemies and slowing their <color=yellow>Movement Speed</color> by {2} for {3} seconds.
St_QR_Innocence.shortDescription: Area Light damage, reduces Movement Speed
St_QR_Innocence.lore:
Once upon a time, there was a very small girl. 
Whenever she saw bad people, her heart would ache. 

So, she would take the shining pieces of her own heart and toss them to the villains. 
Whenever that pure light touched someone, even the worst of hearts would grow gentle. 

The villains would suddenly realize all the wrong they had done, and with tears in their eyes, they would drift off into a deep, peaceful sleep.

St_QR_ValiantHeart.name: Valiant Heart
St_QR_ValiantHeart.description: Swing a magical sword at the nearest enemies, dealing  <sprite=2><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ad>240%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color> and slightly knocking them back. When the sword hits an enemy, Bismuth's <color=yellow>Movement Speed</color> increases by  15%<sprite=5>  for 1 seconds.
St_QR_ValiantHeart.rawDesc: Swing a magical sword at the nearest enemies, dealing {0} <color=yellow>damage</color> and slightly knocking them back. When the sword hits an enemy, Bismuth's <color=yellow>Movement Speed</color> increases by {1} for {2} seconds.
St_QR_ValiantHeart.lore:
The girl firmly believed she was the brave protagonist of a story she was writing herself. 

'Sword of courage, appear!' 

When the girl shouted, 
the old book placed a shining piece of story in her hand. 

When people saw the gleaming sword, they suddenly cried out and rushed toward her. 
They were all villains hiding their wicked hearts! 

'Take this, villains!' 

The girl bravely cut them down one by one with her sword!
St_QR_ValiantHeart.achievementDescription: Enter the Pure White Dream as Bismuth.

St_R_AnnihilationStance.name: Annihilation Stance
St_R_AnnihilationStance.description:
For 10 seconds, envelop your blade with destructive <color=yellow>Sword Energy</color>. While this is active, you cannot <color=yellow>cast</color> <color=yellow>Memories</color>, but your <color=yellow>Attack Damage</color> increases by  35%<sprite=5> , your <color=yellow>Attack Range</color> is increased, and each <color=yellow>Basic Attack</color> fires <color=yellow>Sword Energy</color> that deals  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>340%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Dark Damage</color> to enemies. You can perform  1.5<sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Basic Attacks</color> per second while this effect is active, and this rate is not affected by other Attack Speed effects.

During this time, your <color=yellow>Dodge skill</color> gains  30<sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Memory Haste</color> and 2 <color=yellow>Max Charges</color>.
St_R_AnnihilationStance.rawDesc:
For {0} seconds, envelop your blade with destructive <color=yellow>Sword Energy</color>. While this is active, you cannot <color=yellow>cast</color> <color=yellow>Memories</color>, but your <color=yellow>Attack Damage</color> increases by {1}, your <color=yellow>Attack Range</color> is increased, and each <color=yellow>Basic Attack</color> fires <color=yellow>Sword Energy</color> that deals {2} <color=yellow>Dark Damage</color> to enemies. You can perform {3} <color=yellow>Basic Attacks</color> per second while this effect is active, and this rate is not affected by other Attack Speed effects.

During this time, your <color=yellow>Dodge skill</color> gains {4} <color=yellow>Memory Haste</color> and {5} <color=yellow>Max Charges</color>.

St_R_BaptismOfSun.name: Baptism of the Sun
St_R_BaptismOfSun.description: <color=yellow>Vesper</color> channels the sun's power, unleashing an explosion that deals  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>200%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Fire Damage</color> to nearby enemies and forces them to attack Vesper. Gain  15%<sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Attack Speed</color> for 6 seconds. During this time, <color=yellow>Attacks</color> deal an additional  <sprite=2><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ad>40%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Fire Damage</color>.
St_R_BaptismOfSun.rawDesc: <color=yellow>Vesper</color> channels the sun's power, unleashing an explosion that deals {0} <color=yellow>Fire Damage</color> to nearby enemies and forces them to attack Vesper. Gain {1} <color=yellow>Attack Speed</color> for {2} seconds. During this time, <color=yellow>Attacks</color> deal an additional {3} <color=yellow>Fire Damage</color>.
St_R_BaptismOfSun.lore:
Behold! The light that burns away the world's impurities!
In the sacred crucible, only the will of Lord El'pyros shall remain, pure as gold.

We shall all be baptized! Cry out and give thanks!
St_R_BaptismOfSun.achievementDescription: Defeat the Burning Giant as Vesper while holding 3 or more Fire Memories.

St_R_BlackArbalest.name: Black Arbalest
St_R_BlackArbalest.description: Fires an arbalest bolt that <color=yellow>pierces</color> through enemies, dealing  <sprite=2><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ad>250%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Dark damage</color>, knocking them back, and triggering <color=yellow>attack effects</color>. Each time an enemy is <color=yellow>pierced</color>, the <color=yellow>damage</color> dealt to the next enemy increases by 35%.
St_R_BlackArbalest.rawDesc: Fires an arbalest bolt that <color=yellow>pierces</color> through enemies, dealing {0} <color=yellow>Dark damage</color>, knocking them back, and triggering <color=yellow>attack effects</color>. Each time an enemy is <color=yellow>pierced</color>, the <color=yellow>damage</color> dealt to the next enemy increases by {1}.

St_R_BoneCrusher.name: Bone Crusher
St_R_BoneCrusher.description:
Become <color=yellow>Unstoppable</color> and <color=yellow>dash</color> forward until hitting a wall. Deal  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>135%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color> to enemies you hit and drag them along. Upon hitting a wall, unleash a shockwave that deals  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>420%</gradient></color><color=white><size=80%> + </size></color><color=#7cf248>Bonus<sprite=3></color><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ahp>22%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color> and <color=yellow>stuns</color> for 1.5 seconds.
Gain a <color=yellow>Barrier</color> equal to  20%<sprite=5>  of your <color=yellow>Maximum Health</color>, which disappears 3 seconds after the dash ends.
St_R_BoneCrusher.rawDesc:
Become <color=yellow>Unstoppable</color> and <color=yellow>dash</color> forward until hitting a wall. Deal {0} <color=yellow>damage</color> to enemies you hit and drag them along. Upon hitting a wall, unleash a shockwave that deals {1} <color=yellow>damage</color> and <color=yellow>stuns</color> for {2} seconds.
Gain a <color=yellow>Barrier</color> equal to {3} of your <color=yellow>Maximum Health</color>, which disappears {4} seconds after the dash ends.

St_R_Cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
St_R_Cataclysm.description: Gain a Barrier of  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>150%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  and increase <color=yellow>Ability Power</color> by  30%<sprite=5>  for 12 seconds. During this time, <color=yellow>Cataclysm</color> can be reactivated up to 3 times to drop meteors at target locations. Meteors briefly stun enemies and deal  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>250%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>Light damage</color>.
St_R_Cataclysm.rawDesc: Gain a Barrier of {0} and increase <color=yellow>Ability Power</color> by {1} for {2} seconds. During this time, <color=yellow>Cataclysm</color> can be reactivated up to {3} times to drop meteors at target locations. Meteors briefly stun enemies and deal {4} <color=yellow>Light damage</color>.
St_R_Cataclysm.shortDescription: Increases Ability Power, reactivate to summon meteors
St_R_Cataclysm.lore:
Don't be too hasty, Polaris.
There's no need to despair over your own ignorance.

I'll face the truth with these eyes and choose my path with this heart.

St_R_ChainReaction.name: Chain Reaction
St_R_ChainReaction.description: Inscribe a <color=yellow>Dismantle Sigil</color> at the target location that lasts for 6 seconds. Enemies inside the sigil take  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>150%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  <color=yellow>damage</color> per second, and allies inside heal for  <sprite=1><color=#fff><gradient=sv_ap>44%</gradient></color><sprite=5>  Health per second for each enemy inside. When hitting a <color=yellow>boss</color>, <color=yellow>damage</color> and <color=yellow>healing</color> are increased by 200%.
St_R_ChainReaction.rawDesc: Inscribe a <color=yellow>Dismantle Sigil</color> at the target location that lasts for {0} seconds. Enemies inside the sigil take {1} <color=yellow>damage</color> per second, and allies inside heal for {2} Health per second for each enemy inside. When hitting a <color=yellow>boss</color>, <color=yellow>damage</color> and <color=yellow>healing</color> are increased by {3}.
St_R_ChainReaction.lore:
This is perfect proof of my theory.
Decomposition and combination trigger one another, creating a chain reaction according to the laws I have established.
There are countless ways to use this power, depending on how it is shaped.

I must continue my research.
St_R_ChainReaction.achievementDescription: As Aurena, fully restore your Health in one use of Dangerous Theory when your Health is below 40%.

St_R_Chomp.name: Chomp

The cowards at Arcanum called this theory "unacceptably dangerous."
Fools.

They failed to grasp the elegance of the theory where matter, put under extreme conditions, produces the most explosive results. I am simply proving my hypothesis.

St_R_Immolation.lore:
This frail, weary body will soon become the last shackle that binds me.
Though I have wandered through poverty and pain all my life, not once did I doubt Him. The priest of the Order said, "The purest souls burn themselves to cast off the chains of flesh, and only then can they become light that reaches El'pyros."

I am not afraid.
Rather, I am grateful. That the final moment of this painful life could be so glorious... what greater mercy could there be?

There, I can see the Solar Spire. Soon, I too will become part of that light.
Oh, radiant sun!


- Memory trace from a small burnt body near the Solar Spire.

"Come on, give it all you've got."

"You sure?"

"Yes, go for it!"

The man swung his sword with all his might, only for it to crash against a shield with a resounding metallic clang.

At the same time, a slash mark appeared on the tree behind him.

"What in the world...?"

"Haha, did you see that? I'm invincible now!"


- A memory snippet from a soldier with a scar on the back of his head.

St_R_Smite.lore:
The Society appears to be filled with elders stuck in their ways, their thinking growing fragile and stagnant. How long will they tinker with trivial rules, basking in their so-called achievements?

Observing the tree scorched by lightning last night sparked an idea. Even such immense natural power must operate under certain laws, doesn't it?

If I can uncover these laws, I might be able to wield that force. Just the thought of it is thrilling. I must begin my research immediately.

In this fleeting peace, my soul will once more embrace the light of creation and be renewed, just as the stars dance along their celestial paths...

My existence is driven by one desire:
for you to remain the center of my universe...

St_U_Hysteria.lore:
The nightmare's corruption was not a sudden event. It seeped in slowly, like poison, through the deep wounds he received while protecting the forest.

First, his horns twisted into demonic shapes, even though they once marked him as a forest guardian. Then came his nails. From hands that once nurtured life, black claws grew, ready to tear everything apart. The warmth and mischievous playfulness in his eyes disappeared, replaced by the red light of a starving beast. It was as if his original purpose was being both denied and mocked.

As his reason faded and pure pain and fury took hold of his body, he let out one final, broken breath.

"Nachia... I'm sorry..."

But those words reached no one, fading away at the very moment the last spark of the being called "Belphomet" was extinguished.

This was both his last cry and the first howl of the nightmare that took over his body.

St_U_WorldCracker.lore:
A memory trace of one who was once among the most powerful beings in the world of dreams. It is a fragment of power from one who was king and god of all spirits.

Wielding the authority of divine radiance, he could reduce entire worlds to ashes with a single blow. He challenged the master of worlds but was defeated, and afterward, his whereabouts became unknown. Rumor holds he was imprisoned in another dimension, lost most of his power, and was left as nothing more than an ordinary king.

Yet the whispers told a different story.
They spoke of the symbol of his servitude having disappeared.

but that does not make our existence any less real.

You gave us life,

Is all of this just a pointless fantasy?

...
...
No.

My light, my love, Kiara.
Eternal guide of my soul.
It cannot be so.
A reality without you has no meaning.

Who dares distinguish between illusion and reality?
That line...
Shall vanish today.

Gem_C_Shatter.lore:
As a collector of stories, I simply gather tales. My role and my destiny are to follow a predetermined path from beginning to end. Just as Sisyphus in the old legend came to love his boulder, I have accepted my fate as well.

But you have always been different. You refuse to let your story follow the path set out for you. Whenever I hear you say, "Just because we were born this way does not mean we must live only that way," I feel a small crack forming in my storybook.

Do not misunderstand. This crack is not unpleasant. In fact, it fascinates me. Among the countless stories racing toward their fixed endings, yours is the only one whose next page I cannot predict.

I am eager to see what ending your stubborn defiance will bring. That final chapter may become the most treasured piece in my entire collection.

At the tip of the hollow puppet's blade,
a faint dark energy gathers.

It is not preparation for the next strike.
It is merely a manifestation of emptiness,
revealing the nothingness within.

Paradoxically,
the puppet's sword cuts through enemies
with sharper, more explosive force.

Like a fleeting struggle
toward a void that can never be filled.

Gem_E_Blossom.lore:
Early dawn, and the rain is falling.
It reminds me of that day, when we bloomed flowers together.

I wanted to create a pure white flower, like the quiet dawn.
A child like a lantern, holding all the forest's order and tranquility.

But you, crouched beside me watching, suddenly grumbled.
Then you carelessly scattered deep purple like a storm, and playfully painted over it with lightning-yellow.

I scolded you, and you only laughed.
I truly believed my perfect plan had been ruined by your chaos.

But the next morning, when we looked at that flower together...
Over the pure white serenity, your riotous colors flowed like a living river.

Only then did I understand.
Yes, the forest's true beauty requires both my order and your chaos, intertwined.
Only then does it become complete.

...
The rain... seeps into my mask.
Today, more than ever, I wish I could see
your mischievous eyes again.

Gem_E_Crimson.lore:
I opened my eyes. The trance had ended.
Every joint in my body creaks and groans, yet I feel no pain.

Fragments of memory drift across my hazy consciousness.
The Puppeteer. The client. And the failed contract...
These faint pieces come together at... my master's familiar estate.

Red. Everything is red.
What's this at my feet? Ah, it was a person.

Crimson.

Did I create this? This sea of red?
Indeed, a mountain of corpses in an ocean of blood...

But why?
Why does my heart remain still, without a single ripple?

Gem_E_Direness.lore:
How am I still alive...?

...

I was definitely locked up in the Order's prison.
...Those Lucid bastards had set a trap.
That was my mistake.
I was too hasty.

It's strange.
My breastplate was shattered, and I was sure at least two of my ribs were broken...
But I feel fine. No, I actually feel stronger.

Where am I? Is this some kind of magic...?

...
It's faint, but I can sense it.
Astrid, my sister...
I won't let myself slip up again.

Just wait for me. I'm coming.

Gem_E_Metal.lore:
At the girl's feet, paint shimmered in all colors of the rainbow.

The same lovely shade as the roses Mrs. Maria next door used to grow,
this paint, it smells like metal—just like me!

Urged on by the girl, the book hurriedly wrote the next story using that paint as ink.

Strangely enough, this ink dried unusually fast,
so the book had to turn to the next page without a moment's rest.

Gem_E_Overload.lore:
Every time I reflect on this concept, I feel my body and mind being engulfed in flames.

The scales on the affected areas crumble easily, radiating an intense heat. When I gather the golden dust from certain parts, it shines brilliantly and feels incredibly fine to the touch.

Magic unfolds through the power of dreams, and when this dust is added, the reaction becomes even more explosive. Just a light sprinkle left a large scorch mark on the ceiling.

I should document the results of this experiment, but I'm too drained. This concept seems to inflict a heavy mental toll.

I suspect it's connected to the power I encountered before. It's fascinating, indeed. More research is needed to uncover the source of this power. Perhaps a field study is needed.

For the one who watches over us from above,

I will, rightfully and with honor, sear your skin and carve your flesh.

Hungry... always.
My nest is a mountain of bones.
Flesh... prey... not enough.

But... something new. Came.
Smell of flesh. Smell of fear.

Crush bones. Tear flesh. Swallow screams.
This is my work. This is... Lord Primus's pleasure.

You too... become bones.
Part of my nest.
Lord Primus's... beautiful landscape.

Kik, kikikik.

Gem_E_Virtuousness.lore:
People are dying. Monsters and spirits that once existed only in legends and imagination have crossed into our world, burning villages and destroying lives.

Of all times, it had to be when Lady Camilla and my sister are away...

We can hold out for now, but what if the rumors are true? What if someone's imagination has really become reality?
And what if someone imagined something even more terrible than what we're facing now...?

It's only a matter of time.
Are we supposed to sit here and wait for this inevitable disaster?

...

Yesterday, I managed to infuse my sister's saber and my dagger with the power of dreams.
Now I just need information.

I know someone who can help me.
The Lucid Sect... unsettling as they are, they're probably my best option.

Ignorant and irreverent souls who worship a false god and cling to heretical doctrines. Your blasphemy shall be tolerated no longer.

My mace is the instrument of truth, and my knights bear the calling of the divine. Upon the faithless, judgment shall be delivered.

Tomorrow, the flames of purification shall consume you. Nowhere in this world shall even a trace of their breath remain.

All shall unfold according to the will of El'pyros, Lord of All Creation...

Gem_L_Perfect.lore:
Others once worshipped me as a god.
Yes, there was a time I truly believed I was omnipotent here.

I was reunited with the family I missed so dearly,
and everything I had imagined or dreamed came so easily.

It was perfect...
No, I only believed it was perfect.

A dream, in the end, is still just a dream.
My omnipotence was, in truth, no different from helplessness.

Reality is not a realm of inevitability.
This place... is nothing but an illusion.

Gem_L_PureWhite.lore:
People who have experienced "Molting" all describe their dreamscapes in unique ways.

Some witnessed endless tables piled with meat on silverware, others encountered long-lost relatives, and some found themselves in gardens filled with mood-lifting teas and fragrant roses.

Yet no one has ever truly eaten their fill of that dream food or brought their missing loved ones back to reality.

Our bodies stay firmly in the waking world. Dreams are just brief visits our minds make to the other side. We always wake with empty hands.

That's when the Lucid Sect stumbled onto something incredible.

We can now enter dreams ourselves—in the flesh.

To the girl, adventure is the thrilling act of filling blank pages.
With each step she takes, a new sentence is written, a new character appears.

Gem_R_Contempt.lore:
Day 4 in The Rapids.

I finally have a moment to catch my breath and write again. My whole body still aches, and my hands won't stop shaking, but I have to get this down.

A few days ago, with help from the Lucid Sect, I managed to enter this world called The Rapids. To my surprise, the forest was full of mystery and wonder—sunlight danced between the leaves, and I felt for a brief moment as if I'd stepped into a fairytale.

But it didn't take long to realize that this peacefulness was only a fragile illusion. By afternoon, the fog began to settle, and beyond it, we caught sight of something watching us from the mist.

Even now, my hands tremble as I remember. There was a towering, grotesque creature with smoldering red eyes, its jaw twitching in an unnatural rhythm. In the blink of an eye, it was right in front of us.

Everything after that is a blur. I remember running for my life, my lungs about to burst, the screams of my companions, and the awful sound of flesh being torn apart.


I think I'm safe, for now, but I'll never forget the contempt in its eyes as it tore people apart with those long, cruel claws.

- A.

What a strange and unfamiliar truth this is. What you have shown me is undeniable, the unmistakable touch of fate. Once, I governed the birth and death of stars, their majestic resonance echoing within me completely. Now, everything drifts out of reach, as distant as shadows in the mist.

Yet my will remains clear, bright as the morning star. I will draw the path of my own destiny, and I will break these chains.

Until my final breath, I will remain the one who leads the dance of creation and oblivion. For I am the true god of stars.

Gem_R_Rejuvenation.lore:
Somewhere in a secret place within the Rapids,
a location also known as the Land Between,
the air was filled with the clinking of backpacks.

"Senior! Just by approaching that statue, my creaky joints smooth out and my pack feels lighter! Even my worn shell seems to regain its luster! Why do I feel so rejuvenated?"

The one called senior slowly blinked their multiple eyes
and let out a sigh—
a clear sign of exasperation at the question.

"Because He shares a bit of His yesterday
for our today."

"His... yesterday? Then every time we gain strength, does our Guide... does He molt like us? Or does His shell crack?"

The senior slammed their sturdy claw on the table with a sharp 'THWACK!'

"Ugh, tsk! Does this Jonas have a starfish for brains?! Instead of worrying about nonsense, tighten your pack straps! The power He gave you isn't for polishing your carapace!"


- From the Regular Jonas Gathering

The wound... won't heal.
Beyond the throbbing pain, it devours me
like a living curse.

The eerie violet eyes filling this cavern,
and the floor's patterns glowing as if writhing...
Like an endless scream, they seem to burrow
into my flesh trapped behind these bars.

And among countless eyes, one shines brightest.
He inflicted this wound upon me, then did nothing.
